property_summary: Only the current owner can transfer ownership; a non-owner caller reverts and ownership remains unchanged.

After any successful transferOwnership(newOwner), the public owner getter returns newOwner and the caller's ownership right over further transfers is unchanged; failed transfers leave the owner unchanged.
The owner field can only ever be changed to a new value by the current owner; if a non-owner attempts a transfer, the call reverts and ownership stays the same.
After a successful transferOwnership(newOwner), the public owner getter returns newOwner, and the caller (as the owner before the call) can no longer transfer ownership to a different address.
After a successful transferOwnership(newOwner), any subsequent transferOwnership call reverts, because the caller is no longer the owner.

After a successful transferOwnership by the current owner, the public owner getter returns the new owner for any caller that was not already the owner and cannot be changed by a later call from that same non-owner caller.

After a successful transferOwnership(newOwner), the contract's owner remains newOwner even if the caller later tries to transfer ownership again (which reverts because the caller is no longer the owner).
